url.label: Video or playlist link
url.placeholder: Paste a video or playlist link

probe.idle: Paste a link in the field above to get started.

multi.hint: Each link joins the queue with the default options from Settings.

ambiguous.message: This link is a video inside a playlist.

unsupported.title: Unsupported link
unsupported.message: This address does not look like a site yt-dlp can read. Check the link and try again.

private.title: Video unavailable or private
private.message: The video was removed, is private or needs a login. If you have access to it, use your browser cookies in Settings.

age.title: Age-restricted video
age.message: The site asks you to sign in to confirm your age. Use your browser cookies in Settings.

geo.title: Not available in your region
geo.message: This video is not available in your country. A proxy in Settings may help.

extractor.title: Could not read the site
extractor.message: The site changed or yt-dlp is out of date. Update the engine in Settings and try again.

rate_limit.title: Too many requests
rate_limit.message: The site asked you to wait. Try again in a few minutes.

ffmpeg.title: ffmpeg missing or broken
ffmpeg.message: The app needs ffmpeg to merge and convert files. Reinstall it from the Engine panel.

cookies_chrome.title: Could not read Chrome cookies
cookies_chrome.message: On Windows, Chrome blocks access to its cookies. Use Firefox or turn cookies off in Settings.

disk.title: Problem with the destination folder
disk.message: There is no space or permission to write to the chosen folder. Pick another folder in Settings.

network.title: Connection problem
network.message: Could not reach the site. Check your internet connection and try again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: yt-dlp could not analyze this link. The technical detail below may help.
